name: JV_CI_DISTRIBUTIONS
description: This table contains the tracking distributions for carried interest agreements.

columns.name: CI_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a carried interest distribution.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the joint venture transaction that the carried interest distribution was created from.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for the carried interest agreement.

columns.name: CONSENTING_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is the consenting partner assuming the share for the non-consenting partner.

columns.name: NON_CONSENTING_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that is a non-consenting partner in the carried interest agreement.

columns.name: CONSENTING_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The percent of the non-consenting stakeholder's share that the consenting stakeholder is assuming.

columns.name: NON_CONSENTING_PERCENTAGE
columns.description: The percent of the non-consenting stakeholder's original ownership percent.

columns.name: NCS_DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTED_DR
columns.description: The distribution debit amount for the non-consenting stakeholder in the accounting currency.

columns.name: NCS_DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTED_CR
columns.description: The distribution credit amount for the non-consenting stakeholder in the accounting currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTED_DEBIT
columns.description: The carried debit amount of the carried interest distribution in the accounting currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTED_CREDIT
columns.description: The carried credit amount of the carried interest distribution in the accounting currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code of the source joint venture transaction.

columns.name: NCS_DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_DR
columns.description: The distribution debit amount for the non-consenting stakeholder in the entered currency.

columns.name: NCS_DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_CR
columns.description: The distribution credit amount for the non-consenting stakeholder in the entered currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_DEBIT
columns.description: The carried debit amount of the carried interest distribution in the entered currency.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTED_ENTERED_CREDIT
columns.description: The carried credit amount of the carried interest distribution in the entered currency.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: The currency code entered on the original transaction.

columns.name: CI_DISTRIBUTION_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the type of carried interest distribution line. It is based on ORA_JV_CI_DISTR_LINE_TYPE lookup codes such as Original, Reversed, and so forth.

columns.name: CI_DISTRIBUTION_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Line number used when a carried interest distribution record is reversed, reassigned, or redistributed.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_CI_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the original carried interest distribution line. This is populated on a reversed and reassigned carried interest distribution line.

columns.name: CI_OWNERSHIP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the carried interest ownership definition used to distribute the joint venture transaction.

columns.name: CI_OWNERSHIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the carried interest ownership definition that was used to distribute a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: CI_OWNERSHIP_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the carried interest ownership definition that was used to distribute a joint venture transaction.

columns.name: SOURCE_OWNERSHIP_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the ownership definition that is the source of the carried interest ownership definition.

columns.name: SOURCE_OWNERSHIP_START_DATE
columns.description: Effective start date of the ownership definition that is the source of the carried interest ownership definition.

columns.name: SOURCE_OWNERSHIP_END_DATE
columns.description: Effective end date of the ownership definition that is the source of the carried interest ownership definition.

columns.name: ORIG_CONSENTING_STAKEHOLDER_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the joint venture stakeholder that was the original consenting partner assuming the share for the non-consenting partner on the distribution line.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of transaction the distribution represents, such as Expense, Revenue, and so forth.

columns.name: CI_DISTRIBUTION_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: The status code to identify the accounting status of the carried interest distribution associated with the joint venture transaction. It is based on the ORA_JV_CI_DISTRIBUTION_STATUS lookup codes such as Available to Process, Process Complete, and so forth.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Identifies the transaction ID of the carried interest journal created for the carried interest distribution.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_CODE
columns.description: The code that indicates the reason for changing the carried interest distribution line. It is based on ORA_JV_CHANGE_REASON_CODE lookup codes such as Incorrect ownership percentage, Change in joint operating agreement, and so forth.

columns.name: CHANGE_REASON_ADDITIONAL_TEXT
columns.description: Additional information describing the reason for changing the carried interest distribution line.

columns.name: JV_DISTRIBUTION_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier of the joint venture distribution line associated with this carried interest distribution.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
